headline: Context-aware models partition GWAS loci, map gene-environment and epistatic effects
label: Interpretable Models Of Genetic Architecture
summary: Recent GWAS-scale studies pair structured priors and explainable inference with gene-environment and epistatic genetic architecture.
synthesis: The dominant thread across these items is a shift from marginal, additive association toward genetic models that encode context. J-PEP partitions GWAS loci by jointly clustering pleiotropic SNP effects with tissue epigenomic data, reporting 16%-30% higher PEPA across 165 traits. The GxE compendium maps gene-environment interactions in 440k European and Japanese individuals, replicated in 540k, and links them to polygenic prediction and lipid genetics. EpiDetect applies EpiCID, an explainability algorithm for neural networks, to infer SNP epistatic interaction networks from blood pressure GWAS data. What is new is the pairing of structured priors or explainable inference with large-scale genetic association; machine learning is applied explicitly only in the epistasis study.
